title: Floor Current
prompt: dance pop euro pop, uk garage, fast and high energy
description: A bass-driven UK garage workout at 129 BPM that opens with a pulsing sine sub and stuttering AkaiLinn snares before layering in triangle organ stabs and panned offbeat hats. Two peak sections push the energy into the red, separated by a stripped breakdown that gives the bass room to breathe. Heads-down and groove-locked from start to finish.
